title: MYR Group's Backlog Hits Record in Q2: Can the Growth Trend Continue?
author: Zacks.Com
description: MYR Group achieved a record backlog of $3.16 billion in Q2 2026, up 19.6% year-over-year, driven by strong demand in transmission/distribution and commercial/industrial segments. The company's recent acquisitions of Valley Electric and Comet Electric are expected to expand capabilities and geographic reach. Strong end-market fundamentals in power infrastructure support continued growth, though project execution and cost pressures remain risks.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Record backlog of $3.16B with consistent quarter-over-quarter growth (19.6% YoY), strong segment performance across T&D ($1.27B) and C&I ($1.89B), strategic acquisitions to expand capabilities, Zacks Rank #1 Strong Buy rating, and 54.6% stock gain over past year demonstrate strong growth momentum and positive market outlook.
Record total backlog of $53.4 billion, up 49% year-over-year, with electric backlog representing 82% of total backlog, indicating robust demand in power infrastructure investment.

18-month record backlog of $21.4 billion, up 30% year-over-year, with strong growth in Clean Energy and Infrastructure ($7.8B) and Power Delivery ($6.3B) segments, reflecting sustained demand in power-related infrastructure markets.

title: MYR Group Gains 59% in a Year: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?

title: AGX Falls 28.1% in a Month as Backlog and Margin Risks Come Into Focus
author: Zacks.Com
description: Argan, Inc. (AGX) shares fell 28.1% over a month despite strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results with 61.5% revenue growth and 50.4% earnings increase. The decline reflects investor concerns over backlog contraction from $2.9B to $2.5B, deteriorating margins (gross margin fell to 19.3%, Industrial margin to 7.3%), and unpredictable project award timing. While the company maintains a debt-free balance sheet and strong growth metrics, elevated valuation at 33.1X trailing earnings and execution risks keep the investment case uncertain.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite strong revenue and earnings growth, significant concerns outweigh positives: 28.1% stock decline, backlog fell from $2.9B to $2.5B, gross margins compressed to 19.3% (down from 25%), Industrial margins deteriorated to 7.3%, unpredictable award timing, and premium valuation at 33.1X trailing earnings leaves little room for error.

title: MasTec Trades at a Premium: Should Investors Buy the Stock or Fold?
author: Na
description: MasTec (MTZ) benefits from record $21.4B backlog driven by AI infrastructure and data-center demand, with upward earnings momentum and strategic acquisitions. However, the stock faces headwinds from weak Communications segment performance (11.6% EBITDA decline), negative free cash flow of $59M in Q2, $2.42B net debt, and premium valuation at 20.3x forward P/E. The stock has fallen 19.4% over six months and carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite strong backlog growth and AI infrastructure tailwinds, MTZ faces significant near-term concerns including negative free cash flow (-$59M in Q2), Communications segment EBITDA decline of 11.6%, elevated net debt of $2.42B, and premium valuation. The stock has underperformed peers over six months and carries execution risks that outweigh growth catalysts.
